metaTitle: Custom 15 oz Bar Wine | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom 15 oz bar wine for your event. Perfect for branding with your logo. Bulk pricing available at PerfectImprints.com.
introHtml: Custom 15 oz bar wine glasses offer a generous capacity that suits everything from a full pour of Chardonnay to a hearty serving of sangria. This size is especially popular for corporate hospitality events, trade show receptions, and employee appreciation gatherings where you want guests to enjoy a substantial drink without frequent refills. Available in stemless designs that are stable and easy to hold, these glasses provide ample surface area for your logo or message using screen printing or etching. Choose clear glass for a classic look or opt for frosted finishes to add a touch of elegance.
heroAltText: Custom 15 oz bar wine glasses with etched logo, stemless design for events and corporate gifts.
